item.title: Monitoring Global Temperature and Precipitation in September 2026
item.description: The global surface temperature in September 2026 was 2.39°F (1.33°C) above the 20th-century average—the second-warmest September in the 1850–2026 record, trailing behind the 2023 record by 0.13°F (0.07°C).
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Monitoring the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation in September 2026
item.description: The average temperature for the CONUS in September was 69.4°F, 4.6°F above the 20th-century average. It was the warmest September in the 132-year record, surpassing the previous record set in 1998 (68.95°F).
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: NOAA Hosts 2026 Industry Partnerships Summit
item.description: From September 1-3, 2026, NOAA hosted the 2026 Industry Partnerships Summit at the NOAA Auditorium and Science Center in Silver Spring, MD.
item.dc:creator: madelyn.depodesta

item.title: Exploring with the Gulf Data Atlas
item.description: Explore America’s Third Coast with NOAA’s updated Gulf of America Data Atlas, featuring over 200 interactive maps for data discovery.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Monitoring Global Temperature and Precipitation in August 2026
item.description: The global surface temperature in August 2026 was 2.38°F (1.32°C) above the 20th-century average—the warmest August in the 1850–2026 record, eclipsing the previous tied records set in 2023 and 2024 by 0.14°F (0.08°C).
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Monitoring the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation in August 2026
item.description: The average temperature for the CONUS in August was 75.6°F, 3.5°F above the 20th-century average, while the average for meteorological summer (June–August) was 74.4°F, 3.0°F above average.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Assessing the Global Temperature and Precipitation in July 2026
item.description: Global surface temperatures in July 2026 were 2.12°F (1.18°C) above the 20th-century average, tying 2024 for the warmest July on record.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Assessing the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation in July 2026
item.description: The average temperature for the CONUS in July was 76.9°F, 3.3°F above the 20th-century average.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Assessing the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in June 2026
item.description: The average temperature for the contiguous U.S. in June was 70.6°F, 2.2°F above the 20th-century average.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Assessing the Global Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in June 2026
item.description: Global surface temperatures in June 2026 were 1.96°F (1.09°C) above the 20th-century average—the second-warmest June on record, trailing only 2024.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann
